mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM ainer_identity_notification_outbox WHERE publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND available_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY available_at, created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE ainer_identity_notification_outbox notification SET lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = notification.attempt_count + 1 FROM candidates WHERE notification.id = candidates.id RETURNING notification.id, notification.provisioning_request_id, notification.tenant_id, notification.subject_id, notification.notification_type, notification.template_version, notification.payload_key_version, notification.protected_payload, notification.attempt_count, notification.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_identity_notification_outbox SET publication_status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, payload_key_version = 'destroyed', protected_payload = decode(repeat('00', 32), 'hex'), payload_destroyed_at = #{publishedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
